subject: Senior Inference Engineer reqs — QBR alignment and freeze-exception request
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Senior Inference Engineer reqs — QBR alignment and freeze-exception request

Team —

As we pull together QBR slides next week I want to flag two open reqs in inference that are currently in the hiring queue: 1) Sr. Inference Engineer (req-4892) and 2) Backfill for E2E infra (req-4920). Both are high-touch for the upcoming enterprise pilot in EU.

Quick summary of ask: can we get an exception to the org hiring freeze for req-4892 (senior) and approve a conditional backfill for req-4920 pending a 30-day candidate search? The ask is driven by operational risk to the pilot SLA and OKR sprint commitments (see bullets below).

Why this matters for QBR/OKRs:
- OKR A.1 (Reduce 95p tail latency by 20%): current infra work requires senior attention for kernel-level fixes and model-variant tuning.
- OKR B.2 (Enterprise expansion): EU pilot contract has a committed latency SLA and regression tolerance. Losing subject-matter capacity increases regression risk.

Proposed compromise:
1) Approve req-4892 as an exception with a 90-day hiring review (exec signoff required).
2) Convert req-4920 into a 6-month contractor hire immediately to avoid sprint gaps.
3) Recruiter to start parallel sourcing; provide shortlist by Oct 7.

Attachments: JD_Senior_Inference_v3.pdf (updated), backfill-impact-analysis.xlsx (impact matrix).

Can you confirm if I should prepare a one-pager for execs and whether we have budget headroom? I can include cost delta and risk matrix in the QBR appendix.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Group Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior Inference Engineer reqs — QBR alignment and freeze-exception request

Thanks for the heads up, Rishi. Good framing for QBR. A few quick notes:

- I agree the EU pilot is a material risk. We should aim to show execs the cost of not hiring (quantified) vs the incremental headcount cost.
- Finance will want a cost-neutral plan if possible — can we include a reallocation option (shift 0.5 FTE from non-critical project X)?
- For the backfill-to-contract idea, confirm contractor rate assumptions in the one-pager.

Please prep the one-pager and include a 2-slide appendix: 1) risk vs OKR impact, 2) hiring timeline with critical path.

I can loop in CXO approval if the one-pager makes the case. Schedule a 15-min pre-brief with me before you go to execs.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior Inference Engineer reqs — QBR alignment and freeze-exception request

Following up with some operational detail to help the one-pager. I ran a quick signal analysis and included the shortlist (attached candidate-shortlist.pdf) from Kate. Key points:

- Candidate pool: 7 qualified suspects; 2 strong fits with kernel/quant expertise (one is Priya Singh — external but referred by partner).
- Time-to-signal: without an IC in place we estimate ~6 weeks delay to root-cause for the tail latency regressions. That translates to a potential $80–120k penalty in opportunity cost for the EU pilot window (conservative).
- Option: start 12 weeks contracting engagement for a senior contractor while we run full FT cycle.

Attachments: candidate-shortlist.pdf

If we need to justify to Finance, I can show a phased spend with stop-gaps — start with contractor (6–12 weeks) then convert if candidate fit is strong.

— Markus
Director, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior Inference Engineer reqs — QBR alignment and freeze-exception request

Thanks — ran this past finance ops and procurement. Quick summary of constraints and a suggested route:

- Budget: we have ~2.4 headcount-equivalents in the hiring bucket but three pending reqs claim that capacity. To approve an additional FT we need a reallocation or an exec exception.
- Procurement: contractor route ok; vendor onboarding for a 6-month contractor will take ~7 business days for statement-of-work (SOW) and payment terms.
- Suggested route that minimizes risk to QBR: approve contractor start (max 6 months) for req-4920 immediately, and submit the exec exception for req-4892 with a conditional hiring freeze end date (Dec 31) and a 90-day review. Provide finance with the one-pager and the backfill-impact spreadsheet.

I can draft the exception memo to execs and include the cost-neutral reallocation scenarios Laura asked for. If you approve the draft I will route it for signatures (legal + finance).

— Priyom
Head of Prod Finance (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T16:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Senior Inference Engineer reqs — QBR alignment and freeze-exception request

All —

I reviewed the one-pager and backfill analysis. I will sign off on the contractor route for req-4920 today and will greenlight the exec exception memo for req-4892 on the condition that:

1) The exception memo includes the cost-offset scenarios (2 options).
2) We agree to a 90-day review with measurable milestones (latency 95p improvement checkpoints).
3) Recruiter proceeds with parallel sourcing; shortlist live by Oct 7 and interview loop scheduled Oct 12–19.

Priyom — please route the exception memo and include Legal for a quick compliance check. Markus — please prepare the two milestone checkpoints we can include in the memo. Rishi — I will take the one-pager to the exec pre-brief tomorrow at 09:00; please join for the first 10 minutes.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
